links.comparator_used: Mixtral-8x7B Instruct without a retrieval mechanism (training knowledge alone)
links.outcome: Physician ratings of medical and content accuracy, case relevance, factual integrity and overall usability
links.effect: Physicians did not rate semantic-retrieval RAG responses as superior to those from Mixtral without retrieval across the rated dimensions (no numbers in abstract). Semantic retrieval did improve guideline selection.
links.tradeoff: Retrieval mechanisms often produced answers with linguistic inconsistencies. The performance deficit and error susceptibility were mainly attributed to limits of automated chunk splitting.
links.quote: However, while the semantic retrieval enhanced the guideline selection process, physicians did not rate its responses as superior in terms of medical and content accuracy, case relevance, factual integrity, and overall usability when compared to those from the Mixtral model without a retrieval mechanism.

design_hint: retrieval grounding (RAG) added to an LLM
